answer_1.quote: We study the effect of combination of some styles in the context of generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text continuations conditioned on one or more stylistic attributes (e.g., sentiment, politeness, formality, offense)

answer_2.quote: In automatic evaluation, we calculate F1 score of generated text using the fine-tuned classifiers, to check whether the output text reflects stylistic factor of the target style given.

answer_4.quote: In human evaluation, scores (1-5 Likert scale) annotated by three crowd-workers are averaged on three metrics: stylistic appropriateness, consistency with prompt, and overall coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored generated texts on a 1-5 Likert scale for stylistic appropriateness, consistency with prompt, and overall coherence.
